props.takeaway: Each step prepares the next one

items.title: Step 1: Notice
items.text: What the learner sees or hears that starts the process.

items.title: Step 2: Check
items.text: The one thing to verify before going any further.

items.title: Step 3: Act
items.text: The action itself, described as a short verb phrase.

items.title: Step 4: Report
items.text: Who to tell, and what to tell them, so the loop closes.
